evidence: 61 labelled thumbnails visually inspected; these exact photo IDs are prohibited for the corresponding species as a 4SPECIES hero (or gallery unless separately justified)
caveat: Manual preview image-quality classification, not formal certification of capture circumstances, legal rights, or all future photographs. Captivity/death certainty is labelled, not inferred from absence of evidence.
